newsitem.title: UK: Clyde Petroleum to buy BP stakes in blocks.
newsitem.headline: Clyde Petroleum to buy BP stakes in blocks.

text.p: Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc said it agreed with British Petroleum Co Plc and Broken Hill Proprietary Co Ltd to buy their equity in two UK Continental Shelf blocks. Clyde said it would pay 4.25 million stg in cash on completion of the purchases of the stakes in Blocks 9/14b East and West and a further 4.25 million stg on first production.
BP holds about 91.2 percent in 9/14b East and 82.4 percent in 9/14b West, while BHP holds 8.8 percent in the former and 17.6 percent in the latter, Clyde said in a statement.
"While our plans are still at a very early stage, we would hope to see production from 9/14 making a significant contribution to our overall UK production from mid-1998 onwards," Clyde said.
